start.text: The site is back. The hole is closed. Nothing of the attacker is left. That is the last repair.
start.name: Joshua

A.text: Joshua, eight days. Let us look back at what you learned.
A.name: Carla

B.text: [b][color=green]Day 1[/color][/b]: a second step protects a stolen password. [b][color=green]Day 2[/color][/b]: keep computers updated and install programs only from places you trust.
B.name: Carla

C.text: [b][color=green]Day 3[/color][/b]: keep a backup apart from the network, and test it. [b][color=green]Day 4[/color][/b]: give each person only the access the job needs.
C.name: Carla

D.text: [b][color=green]Day 5[/color][/b]: allow data to go only where it is meant to go. [b][color=green]Day 6[/color][/b]: set a limit that lets customers in and keeps the flood out.
D.name: Carla

E.text: [b][color=green]Day 7[/color][/b]: check the sender and where the link really goes. [b][color=green]Day 8[/color][/b]: check what people type, and keep the software up to date.
E.name: Carla

F.text: Every day looked different, and every day it came down to the same thing: look closely, check before you trust, and fix what you find.
F.name: Joshua

G.text: The week is over. Thank you for keeping the company safe.
G.name: Joshua
